deathbringer.title: Deathbringer points
items: Line up {Reaper's Mark} with big trash pulls and boss burst windows, then use {Exterminate}-empowered {Marrowrend} after it detonates
Split {Vampiric Blood} and {Icebound Fortitude} across big tank busters: {busters}

sanlayn.title: San'layn points
items: Check for 5 {Bone Shield} stacks before these tank busters: {busters}
Line up {Dancing Rune Weapon} with big trash pulls and boss burst windows to stack {Essence of the Blood Queen}

Rav'i: [탱버] Check Bone Shield stacks right before Hydrastrike (three Physical head strikes) and Death Strike right after the hit. If Hydrastrike comes while your health is low, pop Vampiric Blood first.
[광역 피해] Drop Anti-Magic Zone for Ravenous Stomp (145474 Nature to the whole party) to cut the party's magic damage.
[해제] Blood cannot dispel the Regurgitate disease, so leave it to a party member who can. If a wave slows you by 50%, pop Death's Advance to move at normal speed.
[위치] If the empty pile is far, drag the boss there with Death's Advance (10 sec, 35% movement speed).
The Writhing Coil: [탱버] Take Tail Scythe (3 sec cast, 678877 Physical) with Bone Shield stacks up and Death Strike right after the hit. If your health is low, pop Vampiric Blood.
[차단] Put Mind Freeze (15 sec) into the kick rotation for the three back-to-back Toxic Atrophy casts during Toxic Barrage.
[위치] During Uncoil, gather the scattered Uncoiled Writhes with Gorefiend's Grasp, and stun a Writhe casting Toxic Atrophy with Asphyxiate.
Zul'jan: [탱버] For Chop Down (two 484912 Physical hits), keep Bone Shield up, pop Vampiric Blood and Death Strike right after. If Vampiric Blood is not back for the next Chop Down, use Icebound Fortitude.
[위치] Pop Anti-Magic Shell before soaking a Ritual of the Fang beam to absorb its Nature damage, and drop Anti-Magic Zone during the channel while the party soaks the beams (Wowhead).
[위치] Use Death's Advance when your beam spot is far, or when you move the boss to the edge after Axegrinder.

Lightblossom Trinity: [탱버] Bedrock Slam (484912 Physical + 193965 Nature) comes right after the Lightblossom Beam soak; check Bone Shield stacks, add Vampiric Blood on high keys, and Death Strike right after the hit.
[위치] Pop Anti-Magic Shell while standing in Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam; it absorbs both the pool's Nature damage and the beam's Holy damage.
[차단] Interrupt Kezkitt's Light Bolt with Mind Freeze, and if the three bosses drift apart, Death Grip one back to stack them again.
[참고] When Bedrock Surge and Overgrowth overlap, reduce party magic damage with Anti-Magic Zone.
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [위치] Pop Death's Advance before Verdant Stomp; knockback immunity lets you hold the boss outside the root zone.

[해제] Blood cannot free allies from Bloodthorn Roots, so catch the roots in boss AoE to break them fast. Bloodthorn Roots is a magic effect, so Anti-Magic Shell popped before they erupt can keep them off the tank.
[탱버] Use Vampiric Blood for Thorncaller Roar during Frenzy.
[참고] If the party is in danger from AoE damage, drop Anti-Magic Zone to cut magic damage.
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Warden's Wrath in Moonkin Form is repeated Nature (magic) damage on the tank; interrupt it with Mind Freeze and absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell when no kick is available.
[탱버] Keep Bone Shield from dropping during Bear Form and use Dancing Rune Weapon where things overlap. Clear the Grievous Thrash bleed by Death Striking to full health.
[탱버] After 40%, alternate Vampiric Blood and Icebound Fortitude.
Ziekket: [탱버] On the Thornspike cast (193965 Holy + 10 sec Physical bleed), absorb the Holy hit with Anti-Magic Shell and block the knockback with Death's Advance, then heal the bleed with Death Strike.
[차단] Before the revive, interrupt the Lashers' Lightspore Shot with Mind Freeze.
[위치] Gather summoned Lashers in one spot with Gorefiend's Grasp; before the revive, stop their casts with Blinding Sleet.

The Hoardmonger: [위치] When you go to soak Spoiled Supplies mushrooms, pop Death's Advance (10 sec, 35% movement speed) to step on 3-4 mushrooms within 12 sec, and pop Anti-Magic Shell while soaking to absorb the Putrid Burst and Toxic Spores Nature damage.

[참고] Ravenous Bellow and Hearty Bellow are armor-ignoring party Physical damage that Bone Shield does not reduce. If one comes while your health is low, take it with Vampiric Blood and Death Strike to recover.
[위치] After the boss eats the meat pile, block the Hearty Bellow knockback with Death's Advance to hold the boss in place.
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Interrupt Winter's Shroud from the Fractured Shivercore next to the boss (the one the tank and melee take) with Mind Freeze (15 sec), and stun it with Asphyxiate (45 sec) when Mind Freeze is not ready.

[탱버] If you take Frozen Tempest without reaching a Snowdrift or the eye of the storm, pop Anti-Magic Shell (absorbs Frost) and Icebound Fortitude together, and use Death's Advance to walk into a Snowdrift without being pushed.
[위치] If nobody can soak a Rimeshatter, step on it yourself and Death Strike to recover.
Nalorakk: [탱버] Pop Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction) for Overwhelming Onslaught (315193 armor-ignoring Physical × 3). It ignores armor, so Bone Shield does not reduce it.

[탱버] Take the following Forceful Slam (775859 Physical) with Vampiric Blood (1.5 min) and Bone Shield, then Death Strike right after. Popping Death's Advance before Onslaught makes you immune to the final hit's knockback, so you keep your 6 yd soak spot.

[탱버] If you are an Echoing Maul target, pop Anti-Magic Shell to absorb the Echo landing Nature damage (193965). When you body-block Echoes during Fury of the War God, take the Echoing Fury Nature damage with Anti-Magic Shell as well.

Kystia Manaheart: [탱버] Chaos Barrage (3 sec cast, 290947 Chaos) is not reduced by Bone Shield armor; absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec, 7 sec duration). For a Chaos Barrage without Anti-Magic Shell, alternate Icebound Fortitude and Vampiric Blood.
[차단] Interrupt one Mirror Images copy's Felstorm with Mind Freeze, gather the scattered copies with Gorefiend's Grasp to silence them for 3 sec, then lock them down with Blinding Sleet (1 min).
Zaen Bladesorrow: [탱버] Right after the start the workers' melee damage is heavy; pop Dancing Rune Weapon (30% parry) and Vampiric Blood, and Death Grip back a Warehouse Worker that flees at low health.

[탱버] Pre-cast Anti-Magic Shell during the Envenom cast (3 sec cast, 436421 Physical) to keep the following Heartstop Poison off you (Wowhead). Take the Physical hit on Bone Shield and Death Strike right after.
[회피] During Murder in a Row, if the nearest barrel is far, run to it with Death's Advance and hide.
Xathuux the Annihilator: [탱버] Pop Dancing Rune Weapon (30% parry) and Vampiric Blood together for the 15 sec Demonic Rage (75% boss attack speed).
[탱버] Legion Strike (533403 Physical) cuts healing received by 80% for 8 sec, leaving Death Strike almost no healing, so use Icebound Fortitude for the Infernal Crush window right after Axe Toss.
[위치] Use Death's Advance when you move the boss to the Axe Toss axe or back away from the floor fire during Demonic Rage.
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Interrupt Chaos Bolt with Mind Freeze.
[차단] Gather Wild Imp packs with Gorefiend's Grasp to silence them and stop Felfire Burst with Blinding Sleet.
[탱버] Furious Vilefiend's Shadow Bite is magic damage; take it with Anti-Magic Shell.
[위치] Use Death's Advance when repositioning away from the Infernal.

Taz'Rah: [탱버] Void Blast is Shadow damage; absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell and add Vampiric Blood if it hits hard.
[위치] Pop Death's Advance before Void Blast to ignore the knockback and avoid being pushed into ground effects.
[참고] If party damage is high during Dark Bloom, drop Anti-Magic Zone.
Atroxus: [탱버] Pre-cast Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec, 7 sec duration) during the Hulking Claw cast (2 sec cast, 242456 Nature + 10 sec Nature DoT) to absorb the hit and the DoT, then Death Strike to refill (Wowhead).

[탱버] For a Hulking Claw without Anti-Magic Shell, alternate Vampiric Blood (1.5 min) and Icebound Fortitude (2 min). Sickening Bite stacks increase the Nature damage you take, so give the bigger cooldown to that Claw.
[회피] If a Toxic Creeper is about to catch you, open the gap with Death's Advance.
Charonus: [탱버] Absorb Dark Waves (5 sec cast, 339438 Shadow) with Anti-Magic Shell, and stack Icebound Fortitude on keys where it hits hard. Do not spend cooldowns on Cosmic Crash; save them for Dark Waves.
[광역 피해] Drop Anti-Magic Zone while party members drag Gravitic Orbs to the Singularities to cut their Shadow damage.
[위치] If you are a Void Cascade target, pop Death's Advance to block the knockback and keep running in one direction.

The Golden Serpent: [탱버] Take Tail Thrash (1.5 sec cast, 630386 Physical) with Bone Shield up and recover with Death Strike right after the hit.

[제어] When Animated Gold woken by Lucre's Call runs toward the boss, cast Gorefiend's Grasp (1.5 min) on an add far from the boss to bunch them up, then drop Death and Decay on them so Grip of the Dead slows them by 90% (Wowhead).

[위치] With the boss parked in the corner behind the stairs, pop Death's Advance on the Serpentine Gust cast (Nature damage + push-back for 5 sec) so you are not pushed, and absorb the Nature damage with Anti-Magic Shell.
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Mind Freeze on the mummies' Wretched Discharge first; if it is missed, stop the cast with Death Grip.
[위치] If awakened mummies scatter, gather them next to the boss with Gorefiend's Grasp.
[위치] During the Entomb coffin search, use Death's Advance to reach the far coffins quickly.
The Council of Tribes: [탱버] Pop Vampiric Blood (1.5 min) during Aka'ali's Debilitating Backhand cast (2 sec cast, 727368 Physical), and stack Icebound Fortitude (2 min) during Shattered Defenses, which increases Physical damage taken by 200%.

[위치] Popping Death's Advance just before Backhand prevents the knockback. On a Backhand without a big cooldown, use the extra Death's Advance charge from Death's Echo to kite until Shattered Defenses ends.
[탱버] Absorb the Arc Lightning (1 sec cast, 135775 Nature) that hits you right after engaging Zanazal with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec, 7 sec duration), and pop it again on cooldown as it keeps coming.
[차단] Assign Mind Freeze to Zanazal's Poison Nova (4 sec cast, 12 sec poison) so it is always interrupted.
Dazar, The First King: [탱버] Spend cooldowns one at a time, in the order Vampiric Blood → Dancing Rune Weapon → Icebound Fortitude, on the moment T'zala's Savage Maul (193965 Physical + 10 sec bleed) is followed by Blade Combo. Do not use big cooldowns in phase 1 (100-80%); save them for this overlap.
[탱버] Recover from the bleed with Death Strike as soon as Blade Combo ends. Ask for an external on an overlap where all three cooldowns are down.
[차단] Interrupt Reban's Deathly Roar (4 sec cast, Shadow damage + 4 sec fear) with Mind Freeze, and if the kick will be missed, pop Lichborne (2 min) before the cast finishes so you are not feared.
[위치] Taunt T'zala with Dark Command the moment it joins at 80%.

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] Frigid Shard (2.5 sec cast, 775859 Physical) is cast right after the pull, so interrupt it with Mind Freeze (15 sec) from the very first cast (Wowhead). After that, interrupt it right after the Hailburst ice lands and drag the boss off the ice.
[탱버] Take a Frigid Shard that Mind Freeze missed with Vampiric Blood (1.5 min) and recover with Death Strike right after the hit.

[해제] When Infused Whelps spawn at the 66% and 33% intermissions, pop Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec, 7 sec duration) so Cold Claws (Magic) stacks cannot be applied, gather the whelps on the boss with Gorefiend's Grasp, and grab threat with Blood Boil.
[광역 피해] Drop Anti-Magic Zone (15% party magic damage reduction) for the Frost Overload window (45582 party Frost every 1.5 sec) of the intermission, when whelps and Ice Bulwark are up together.
Kokia Blazehoof: [탱버] Pop Dancing Rune Weapon (2 min, 30% parry) for Searing Blows (4 hits over 3 sec, each stacking an 8 sec Searing Wounds Fire DoT). Parried or avoided hits leave no DoT (Wowhead).

[탱버] Absorb the Searing Wounds left by unparried hits with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec, 7 sec duration) (Wowhead). For a Searing Blows without Dancing Rune Weapon, pop Vampiric Blood (1.5 min), and on high keys stack it with Anti-Magic Shell.
[차단] Assign Mind Freeze to Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 party Fire).
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [탱버] Take Erkhart's Stormslam (2.5 sec cast, 387930 Physical + 193965 Nature + 100% more Nature damage taken for 30 sec) with Bone Shield and Death Strike; do not use Vampiric Blood or Icebound Fortitude on it. Only when you are not an Inferno Spit target, pre-cast Anti-Magic Shell to absorb the Nature damage and keep the Nature vulnerability (Magic) debuff off you.

[탱버] If you are an Inferno Spit target (6 sec Fire DoT, then an 8 yd explosion), pop Anti-Magic Shell (7 sec duration) right away to absorb both the DoT and the explosion. If Anti-Magic Shell is down, take it with Icebound Fortitude.
[탱버] Phase 2 Inferno Spit targets three players, so keep one of Vampiric Blood or Icebound Fortitude for phase 2.
[위치] Pop Death's Advance during Winds of Change (push for 8 sec) so you are not pushed and keep the boss in place.

Adderis & Aspix: [탱버] Keep Bone Shield up during Overload and use Vampiric Blood if it overlaps.
[위치] Pop Death's Advance before Gale Force to ignore the knockback and hold your Thunder and Lightning soak spot.
[참고] Drop Anti-Magic Zone during the Thunder and Lightning soak to reduce party damage.
Merektha: [탱버] Use a cooldown on every Lightning Bite (3 sec cast, 533403 Physical + 7 sec Nature DoT). Pop Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec, 7 sec duration) during the cast to absorb the Nature DoT (Wowhead), and alternate Vampiric Blood (1.5 min) and Icebound Fortitude (2 min) on top of it for the Physical hit.
[위치] When Hatch opens the eggs, Death Grip the Storm Serpent to you and take threat before it reaches a damage dealer.

[광역 피해] For Serpentstorm (4 sec cast, party knockback + Nature damage + 8 sec DoT), drop Anti-Magic Zone (15% party magic damage reduction) and pop Death's Advance to block the knockback so you are not pushed into a pool.
[차단] Interrupt Toxic Viper's Poison Spit with Mind Freeze, and gather the snakes that scatter after A Knot of Snakes with Gorefiend's Grasp.
Galvazzt: [위치] Do not block Lightning Spire beams; each time an Induction Field forms, move the boss quickly to the next corner with Death's Advance (35% movement speed).
[광역 피해] When Induction (3 sec cast, 145474 party-wide Nature) overlaps with the beam soakers' Galvanized DoT, drop Anti-Magic Zone to cut party Nature damage by 15%.
[참고] If a beam soaker dies, bring them back right away with Raise Ally.
Avatar of Sethraliss: [탱버] Pop Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec, 7 sec duration) during Corrupted Guardian's Tainted Strike cast (2.5 sec cast, 484912 Physical + stacking 25 sec Shadow DoT) to absorb the Shadow DoT (Wowhead). If stacks have built up, pop Vampiric Blood to boost Death Strike healing.
[위치] When a Corrupted Guardian appears at a purple floor marker, taunt it right away with Dark Command.
[차단] Interrupt Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock (4 sec cast, 242456 Fire + 8 sec DoT) with Mind Freeze.
[제어] In phase 2, gather the Faithless Tormentor packs chasing the healer with Gorefiend's Grasp, then drop Death and Decay so Grip of the Dead slows them.

221562.m: Talent · 20 yd range · Instant · 45 sec cooldown
221562.d: Lifts the enemy target off the ground, crushing their throat with dark energy and stunning them for 5 sec.

273946.d: Each enemy hit by Blood Boil increases the damage and healing done by your next Death Strike by 8%, stacking up to 5 times.

391477.d: Enemies affected by Blood Plague take 5% increased damage from you and Death Strike increases the damage of your Blood Plague by 10% for 15 sec, stacking up to 4 times.

433895.m: 1 Rune / -10 Runic Power · Melee Range · Instant
433895.d:
A vampiric strike that deals (113.375% of Attack Power) Shadow damage and heals you for 2% of your maximum health.
Additionally grants you Essence of the Blood Queen for 20 sec.

433925.d:
Blood (Blood Death Knight)
Essence of the Blood Queen empowers you, increasing your Haste by 1.0% up to 5.0% for 20 sec.

434152.d:
While Dancing Rune Weapon is active you gain Gift of the San'layn.
Gift of the San'layn increases the effectiveness of your Essence of the Blood Queen by 200%, and Vampiric Strike replaces your Heart Strike for the duration.

439843.m: Talent · 2 Runes · Melee Range · Instant · 45 sec cooldown
439843.d:
Viciously slice into the soul of your enemy, dealing (530.712% of Attack Power) Shadowfrost damage and applying Reaper's Mark.
Each time you deal Shadow or Frost damage, add a stack of Reaper's Mark. After 12 sec or reaching 40 stacks, the mark explodes, dealing (54.4176% of Attack Power) damage per stack.
Reaper's Mark travels to an unmarked enemy nearby if the target dies.

441378.d:
After Reaper's Mark explodes, your next 2 Marrowrends cost 1 Rune and summon 2 scythes to strike your enemies.
The first scythe strikes your target for (1287.81% of Attack Power) Shadowfrost damage and the second scythe strikes all enemies around your target for (572.424% of Attack Power) Shadowfrost damage[and applies Frost Fever]. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

1263569.m: Talent · 20 yd range · Instant · 2 min cooldown
1263569.d:
Sprout an additional limb, pulling enemies further than 8 yds from you every 1 sec.  
The same enemy can only be pulled once every 4 sec.

1265790.d: Heart Strike has a chance to make your next Blood Boil empowered, dealing 50% increased damage and echoing after 3 sec.

205727.d: Reduces the cooldown of Anti-Magic Shell by 20 sec and increases its duration and amount absorbed by 40%.

356367.d: Death's Advance, Death and Decay, and Death Grip have 1 additional charge.

273952.d: [Defile / Death and Decay] reduces the movement speed of enemies within its area by 90%, decaying by 10% every sec.

3714.d:
냉기를 발산해 10분 동안 50미터 내에 있는 파티원 또는 공격대원의 발 아래 얼음을 만들어 수면을 걸을 수 있게 합니다.
탈것을 탄 상태에서 사용할 수 있습니다. 공격을 받거나 피해를 입으면 효과가 사라집니다.

43265.m: 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15초 후 재사용 가능 · 1회 사용 가능
43265.d:
대상 지면에 부패를 유발하여 해당 범위 내의 적에게 [(전투력의 8.3%) * 11]의 암흑 피해를 10초에 걸쳐 입힙니다.
[
해당 지역 안에 머무르는 동안에는 심장 강타가 최대 0명의 추가 대상에게 적중합니다.]

45524.m: 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
45524.d: 대상을 얼음의 사슬로 속박하여, 8초 동안 이동 속도를 70%만큼 감소시킵니다.

46585.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
46585.d: [문양: 외눈깨비: 외눈깨비 / 구울]을 소환하여 자신을 도와 싸우게 합니다. 동시에 하나의 [문양: 외눈깨비: 외눈깨비 / 구울]만 부릴 수 있습니다. 1분 동안 지속됩니다.

47528.m: 특성 · 15 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
47528.d: 대상의 정신을 냉기로 얼려 주문 시전을 방해하고 5초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하도록 만듭니다.

47541.d:
부정한 마력을 발사해 적에게는 (전투력의 211.812%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고, 언데드 아군은 (전투력의 463.75%)의 생명력을 회복시킵니다.
공포의 역병과 악성 역병의 지속시간이 1.0초만큼 증가합니다.

48265.m: 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
48265.d:
10초 동안 이동 속도가 35%만큼 증가하며, 평상시 이동 속도의 최소 100%를 유지합니다. 강제 이동 효과 및 밀쳐내기에 면역이 됩니다.
지속효과: 평상시 이동 속도의 최소 70%를 유지합니다.

48707.d: 5초 동안 자신을 대마법 보호막으로 감싸 최대 [총 생명력 * 30 / 100 * (1 + 유연성) * 1 * 1]의 마법 피해를 흡수하고, 해로운 마법 효과에 걸리지 않게 합니다. 피해를 흡수하면 룬 마력이 생성됩니다.

48792.d: 피가 얼어붙어 8초 동안 기절 효과에 면역이 되고, 받는 모든 피해가 30%만큼 감소합니다.

49028.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
49028.d:
8초 동안 자신의 근접 공격과 동일한 공격을 펼치고 방어를 돕는 룬 무기를 소환합니다.
활성화되어 있는 동안 무기 막기 확률이 30%만큼 증가합니다.

49039.d: 부정의 에너지를 끌어내 10초 동안 언데드가 되어, 생기흡수가 6%만큼 증가하고 현혹과 공포, 수면에 면역이 됩니다.

49576.m: 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15초 후 재사용 가능 · 1회 사용 가능
49576.d: 모든 물질을 감싸고 결합시키는 힘을 이용해 대상을 끌어당 [ 혈기: 겨 당신을 공격하게 합니다 /

49998.m: 특성 · 룬 마력 45 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시
49998.d: 일격에 어둠의 힘을 집중시켜 (전투력의 176.1%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 또한, 지난 5초 동안 받은 모든 피해의 (20 / 탐식: 21 / 죽음의 일격 연마: 32)%에 해당하는 만큼 자신의 생명력을 치유합니다. 최소 치유량은 최대 생명력의 7.0%입니다.

50842.m: 특성 · 즉시 · 7.5 초 재사용 대기시간 · 2회 사용 가능
50842.d:
(전투력의 164%)의 암흑 피해를 10미터 내의 모든 적에게 입히고 추가로 피의 역병에 감염시킵니다.
 피의 역병
어둠의 질병을 일으켜 24초에 걸쳐 대상의 생명력을 총 64만큼 흡수합니다.

51052.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 4 분 재사용 대기시간
51052.d: 6초 동안 거대한 대마법 지대를 생성하여 내부의 파티원이나 공격대원이 받는 마법 피해를 15%만큼 감소시킵니다.

53428.d: 무기에 룬의 마력을 불어넣는 방법을 배웁니다.

55078.d: 어둠의 질병을 일으켜 24초에 걸쳐 대상의 생명력을 총 64만큼 흡수합니다.

55233.d: 불사의 은총을 받아들여 10초 동안 최대 생명력이 30%만큼, 받는 치유 효과와 피해 흡수량이 30%만큼 증가합니다.

56222.m: 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간
56222.d: 적을 호령하여 자신을 공격하게 합니다. 6초 동안 대상을 향해 생성되는 위협 수준이 800%만큼 증가합니다.

61999.m: 룬 마력 30 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 10 분 재사용 대기시간
61999.d: 죽은 대상의 영혼과 육체를 암흑의 기운으로 재결합시켜, 60%의 생명력과 최소 20%의 마나를 지닌 상태로 부활하게 합니다.

77535.d:
혈기의 형상일 때 죽음의 일격으로 피해를 입힐 때마다 획득한 생명력의 일정 비율을 물리 피해 흡수 보호막으로 만듭니다. (500밀리초 재사용 대기시간)
Modifies Damage/Healing Done 0%: 
고름 일격, 골수분쇄, 공포의 실험, 돌발 열병, 룬의 일격, 부덕한 자의 굴레, 부정의 습격, 부정의 파멸충, 사신의 징표, 서리 열병, 서리낫, 섭취, 스컬지의 일격, 심장 강타, 영혼 수확자, 우월종, 울부짖는 한파, 죽음의 마수, 죽음의 일격, 지옥족쇄, 지옥족쇄, 참혹한 부패, 피 들이키기, 피의 소용돌이, 피의 소용돌이, 피의 역병, 할퀴는 어둠, 혹한 전염, 흉물 사지, 흉물 사지

81136.d: 피의 역병에 감염된 대상을 자동 공격으로 공격하면 25%의 확률로 다음 죽음과 부패가 룬을 소모하지 않고, 재사용 대기시간이 초기화됩니다. (효과 발동 확률: 25%)

108199.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
108199.d: 적 또는 아군 대상으로부터 15미터 반경 내의 적들을 어둠의 촉수로 휘감아 대상 위치로 끌어당기고 3초 동안 침묵시킵니다.

111673.m: 특성 · 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 1.5 초 주문 시전 시간
111673.d: 최대 38 레벨의 대상 언데드를 지배하여 자신의 명령을 따르게 합니다. 5분 동안 지속됩니다.

114556.d:
부정한 서약의 힘으로 죽음에 이르는 치명적인 공격를 막아내고, 대신 막아낸 피해량만큼 받는 치유 효과를 흡수합니다. 3초 동안 지속됩니다.
효과가 사라지기 전까지 필요한 치유량을 다 받지 못하면 죽음을 맞습니다. 이 효과는 4분마다 한 번씩만 발동합니다.

195181.d: 소용돌이치는 뼈의 보호막으로 자신을 감싸 방어도를 (180 * 힘 / 100)만큼 [골수분쇄: 가속을 0%만큼] 증가시킵니다. 근접 공격을 받을 때마다 뼈의 보호막 1중첩이 소모됩니다. 30초 동안 또는 중첩이 모두 소모될 때까지 지속됩니다. (2.5초 재사용 대기시간)

195182.m: 특성 · 룬 2 / 룬 마력 -20 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시
195182.d:
대상을 강타하여 (전투력의 220.65%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 뼈의 보호막 충전 3개를 생성합니다.
 뼈의 보호막
소용돌이치는 뼈의 보호막으로 자신을 감싸 방어도를 (180 * 힘 / 100)만큼 [골수분쇄: 가속을 0%만큼] 증가시킵니다. 근접 공격을 받을 때마다 뼈의 보호막 1중첩이 소모됩니다. 30초 동안 또는 중첩이 모두 소모될 때까지 지속됩니다.

195292.m: 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 6 초 재사용 대기시간
195292.d:
괴저 촉수를 뻗어 대상에게 (전투력의 43.74%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 피의 역병에 감염시키며 뼈의 보호막 충전을 2개 생성합니다.
 피의 역병
어둠의 질병을 일으켜 24초에 걸쳐 대상의 생명력을 총 64만큼 흡수합니다.

206930.m: 특성 · 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -15 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시
206930.d: 즉시 대상과 주위의 적 하나를 강타하여 (전투력의 196.7%)의 물리 피해를 입히고, 8초 동안 적의 이동 속도를 20%만큼 감소시킵니다. [심장 강타: 5의 추가 룬 마력을 생성합니다.] [심장파괴자: 적중한 대상 하나당 2의 룬 마력이 추가로 생성됩니다].

207167.d:
전방 부채꼴 범위에 있는 대상의 눈을 멀게 하여 5초 동안 방향 감각을 상실하고 방황하게 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 입으면 효과가 취소될 수 있습니다.
눈부신 진눈깨비가 종료되면 6초 동안 적의 이동 속도가 50%만큼 감소합니다.

212552.m: 특성 · 집중 (4 초 주문 시전 시간) · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
212552.d:
어둠땅의 힘을 받아들여 모든 이동 불가 효과를 해제하고 4초 동안 이동 속도를 70%만큼 증가시킵니다. 이동 외의 행동을 취하면 이 효과는 취소됩니다.
효과가 활성화되어 있는 동안에는 평상시 이동 속도의 170% 미만으로 감소하지 않습니다.

219786.d:
뼈의 보호막이 5회 이상 충전되어 있는 동안, 죽음의 일격에 소모되는 룬 마력이 5만큼 감소합니다.
추가로, 최대 룬 마력이 10만큼 증가합니다.

221562.m: 특성 · 20 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
221562.d: 암흑 마력으로 적 대상을 지면에서 들어올리고 목을 휘감아 5초 동안 기절시킵니다.

273946.d: 피의 소용돌이에 적중한 적 하나당 다음 죽음의 일격의 공격력과 치유량이 8%만큼 증가합니다. 최대 5번까지 중첩됩니다.

391477.d: 피의 역병에 영향을 받는 적에게 입히는 피해가 5%만큼 증가합니다. 또한 죽음의 일격이 15초 동안 피의 역병의 공격력을 10%만큼 증가시킵니다. 최대 4번까지 중첩됩니다.

433895.m: 룬 1 / 룬 마력 -10 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시
433895.d:
흡혈의 일격을 가해 (전투력의 113.375%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 최대 생명력의 2%만큼 생명력을 회복합니다.
추가로 20초 동안 피의 여왕의 정수가 부여됩니다.

433925.d:
혈기 (혈기 죽음의 기사)
피의 여왕의 정수로 강화되어 가속이 1.0%만큼, 최대 5.0%만큼 증가합니다. 20초 동안 지속됩니다.

434152.d:
춤추는 룬 무기이 활성화된 동안 산레인의 선물 효과를 얻습니다.
산레인의 선물은 피의 여왕의 정수 효과를 200%만큼 증가시키며, 지속시간 동안 흡혈의 일격이 심장 강타을 대체합니다.

439843.m: 특성 · 룬 2 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
439843.d:
매섭게 적의 영혼을 베어 (전투력의 530.712%)의 암흑냉기 피해를 입히고 사신의 징표를 겁니다.
암흑 또는 냉기 피해를 입힐 때마다 사신의 징표 중첩을 부여합니다. 12초 후에 또는 40번 중첩 시 징표가 폭발해 중첩 하나당 (전투력의 54.4176%)의 피해를 입힙니다.
대상이 사망할 경우 사신의 징표는 징표에 걸리지 않은 주위의 적에게 전이됩니다.

441378.d:
사신의 징표가 폭발한 후에 다음 2회의 골수분쇄이 룬 1개를 소모하며 낫 2개를 소환해 적을 가격합니다.
첫 번째 낫은 대상을 가격해 (전투력의 1287.81%)의 암흑냉기 피해를 입히고, 두 번째 낫은 대상 주위의 모든 적을 가격해 (전투력의 572.424%)의 암흑냉기 피해를 입히고[추가로 서리 열병을 부여합니다.] 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

1263569.m: 특성 · 20 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
1263569.d:
몸에서 새로운 신체가 돋아나 1초마다 8미터 이상 떨어진 적을 자신의 위치로 끌어당깁니다. 
4초에 한 번씩만 같은 적을 끌어당길 수 있습니다.

1265790.d: 심장 강타 사용 시 일정 확률로 다음 피의 소용돌이가 강화되어 50%의 추가 피해를 입히고 3초 후에 메아리치게 합니다.

205727.d: 대마법 보호막의 재사용 대기시간이 20초만큼 감소하고, 지속시간과 흡수량이 40%만큼 증가합니다.

356367.d: 죽음의 진군, 죽음과 부패, 죽음의 손아귀가 추가로 1회 충전됩니다.

273952.d: [파멸 / 죽음과 부패]이 범위 안에 있는 적의 이동 속도를 90%만큼 감소시킵니다. 이 효과는 1초마다 10%만큼 감소합니다.

1: [탱버] When Virid Grovekeeper casts Earthrupture Strike (533403 Physical, 2.5 sec cast), pop Vampiric Blood (1.5 min) and Death Strike right after the hit.
[탱버] Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret is Holy damage that Bone Shield armor does not reduce; absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration).
[위치] If Radiant Spellsower runs to a Lasher pack with Call The Grove, Death Grip it back; if it is already channeling Frantic Blooming, stun it with Asphyxiate (45 sec).
2: [탱버] Use Anti-Magic Shell for Spouting Floret. If the Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec) used on pull 1 is not back yet, pull this pack a little later.

[차단] Put Mind Freeze (15 sec) into the Light Bolt Volley kick rotation for the two Radiant Spellsowers, and Death Grip the other one (2 charges with Death's Echo) to cancel its cast and stack it on you.
3: [탱버] For Earthrupture Strike, use Vampiric Blood (1.5 min) if it is back from pull 1; otherwise use Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction).
[참고] When Spore Spines slows stack up from 12 Lashers, pop Death's Advance; for 10 sec you cannot be slowed below 100% speed.
[차단] Interrupt Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley with Mind Freeze, and Death Grip a Radiant Spellsower back when it flees with Call The Grove.
5: [탱버] Use Anti-Magic Shell for Spouting Floret from the Sporeblight Belcher you pull first, and Vampiric Blood or Icebound Fortitude for Earthrupture Strike from the Virid Grovekeeper pulled 5-6 sec later. Different schools let you split the cooldowns.
[위치] When you see the Uproot cast (3 sec), pop Death's Advance; you are immune to knockbacks for 10 sec and stay on the pack.
[차단] Interrupt Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Mind Freeze, and stun Thorny Saptor with Asphyxiate to stop the Thornclaw Leap follow-up attacks.
7: [탱버] When Grievous Gash (387930 Physical + stacking bleed) from the two Luminous Thornmaws overlaps, pop Vampiric Blood; 30% more healing and absorbs makes it easier to Death Strike to full and clear the bleed. Use Icebound Fortitude on the next overlap.
[차단] Interrupt Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast) with Mind Freeze; if missed, the tank is disoriented for 3 sec and loses both Thornmaws.
[제어] Stun the Thorny Saptor that leaps with Thornclaw Leap using Asphyxiate (45 sec) to stop the follow-up attacks.
8: [탱버] Pop Anti-Magic Shell for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret to absorb the Holy damage.
[위치] The two Leafy Grovecrawlers shoot Seed Shot from range; Death Grip them (2 charges) into the pack and Mind Freeze the Seed Shot they recast after landing.
10: [탱버] Take Potatoad Matriarch's Tongue Toss (290947 Physical + knock-up) with Bone Shield stacks up and Death Strike as soon as you land. It is a long fight, so alternate Vampiric Blood and Icebound Fortitude.
[참고] Blood cannot dispel the Toxic Spew poison. When you see the 2 sec cast, pop Anti-Magic Shell to absorb the initial Nature hit and the poison ticks.
[탱버] When Lightgorged Lasher activates Lightbloom Pollination, nearby mobs gain 50% attack speed; pop Dancing Rune Weapon (2 min, 30% parry) to cut the melee damage.
11: [탱버] Use Anti-Magic Shell for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret and Vampiric Blood for Luminous Thornmaw's Grievous Gash. Different schools mean the two cooldowns never overlap.
[차단] If the three Lightfeather Petalwings cast Disorienting Screech together, stop the Petalwings grouped in front of you at once with Blinding Sleet (1 min) and Mind Freeze the last one.
12: [탱버] When the six Lightgorged Lashers activate Lightbloom Pollination, nearby mobs gain 50% attack speed; pop Dancing Rune Weapon (2 min, 30% parry) and do not hold back on Death Strike.
[탱버] Pop Anti-Magic Shell for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret.
[차단] Interrupt the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley with Mind Freeze and Death Grip, and stun one with Asphyxiate if it flees with Call The Grove.

1: [차단] For the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss (armor-ignoring Physical, 30% haste reduction), interrupt one with Mind Freeze (15 sec) and Death Grip the other (2 charges with Death's Echo) to cancel its cast.
[탱버] When Ravenous Claws attack speed stacks build on the seven Ravenous Descendants, pop Dancing Rune Weapon (2 min, 30% parry), and add Vampiric Blood (1.5 min) if your health still drops.

[탱버] Twinfang Harrower's Toxic Breath and Paralyzing Shots are Nature damage; absorb them with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration). Paralyzing Shots is a magic effect, so a pre-cast Anti-Magic Shell keeps the slowing DoT off you.
2: [탱버] Pop Vampiric Blood for Ritual Chieftain's Dismember (3 sec cast, 581895 Physical) and Death Strike right after the hit. If you used Vampiric Blood on pull 1, take it with Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction).
[제어] Stun a long-lived Ravenous Descendant with high Ravenous Claws stacks using Asphyxiate (45 sec) for 5 sec. Each stack only lasts 2 sec, so they fall off during the stun.
3: [위치] Break line of sight behind the pillar so the three Primal Serpents walk to you, and Death Grip the one that keeps standing still to cast.
[차단] Take one of the three Piercing Hiss casters with Mind Freeze, and if kicks run short, stop the cast with your second Death Grip charge or Asphyxiate.
[탱버] Use the cooldown you did not use on pull 2 for Dismember. Alternate Vampiric Blood (1.5 min) and Icebound Fortitude (2 min) across the Dismembers on pulls 2, 3, 4 and 5.
4: [탱버] Use Vampiric Blood for Dismember if it is back from pull 2; if not, take the hit with Bone Shield stacks up and Death Strike right after.
[차단] Interrupt the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss one each with Mind Freeze and Death Grip.
5: [탱버] Use Icebound Fortitude for Ritual Chieftain's Dismember if it is back from pull 3. Blood Sacrifice and Paralyzing Shots overlap here and healing runs short, so do not hold back on Death Strike.
[탱버] Take the two Twinfang Harrowers' Toxic Breath (67888 Nature every 0.5 sec) with Anti-Magic Shell, and turn the pack away from the party so the frontals miss them.
[광역 피해] When Paralyzing Shots Nature DoTs spread across the party, drop Anti-Magic Zone (6 sec, 15% magic damage reduction), and ignore the slow on yourself with Death's Advance.
7: [탱버] Pre-cast Anti-Magic Shell during Rattling Writhe's Corrosive Fangs cast (3 sec cast, 242456 Nature, 20% increased damage taken for 20 sec) to absorb it (Wowhead).
[차단] Interrupt High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom with Mind Freeze, and Death Grip it to cancel the Evolve channel. A finished Evolve grants a shield and crowd control immunity.
8: [탱버] Use Anti-Magic Shell for Corrosive Fangs if it is back from pull 7 (40 sec); otherwise take it with Vampiric Blood.
9: [탱버] Absorb Rattling Writhe's Corrosive Fangs with Anti-Magic Shell.
[위치] Death Grip (30 yd) the High Evolutionist standing far to the left into the pack, and interrupt the Mass Envenom that follows with Mind Freeze.
11: [차단] If the four High Evolutionists cast from separate spots, gather them with Gorefiend's Grasp (1.5 min) to silence them for 3 sec, then interrupt the following Mass Envenom with Mind Freeze.
[차단] Stop the Evolve channel with Death Grip (2 charges) or Asphyxiate (45 sec).
12: [탱버] Pop Anti-Magic Shell for Ascendant Serpent's Noxious Spray (67888 Nature every 1 sec for 5 sec) to absorb it (Wowhead), and aim the spray away from the party.
[위치] Pop Death's Advance while Noxious Spray pushes you back; immunity to forced movement lets you hold your spot.
[광역 피해] Drop Anti-Magic Zone where the party stacks when the Infest eggs burst (69827 Nature within 8 yd).
13: [차단] Put Mind Freeze into the Mass Envenom kick rotation for Ula'tek's Chosen.
[광역 피해] When Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every 1 sec for 9 sec) starts, drop Anti-Magic Zone, and stun one teleporting Blade of the Altar with Asphyxiate.
14: [광역 피해] If you used Anti-Magic Zone on pull 13, absorb only your own Nature damage from this Toxic Surge with Anti-Magic Shell, and stun one Blade of the Altar with Asphyxiate.
[차단] Interrupt Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom with Mind Freeze.
15: [탱버] Pop Anti-Magic Shell to absorb the Nature damage from Twinfang Harrower's Toxic Breath and Paralyzing Shots (Wowhead).
[차단] Interrupt the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss one each with Mind Freeze and Death Grip.
16: [탱버] The two Ritual Chieftains' Dismembers (581895 Physical) come back to back; take the first with Vampiric Blood and the second with Icebound Fortitude. Save both cooldowns through pulls 14 and 15 for this pull.

[광역 피해] When Ula'tek's Chosen starts Toxic Surge, drop Anti-Magic Zone to cut the Nature damage. Blood Sacrifice is Physical and Anti-Magic Zone does not reduce it, so Death Strike to refill your own health then.
[차단] Interrupt Mass Envenom with Mind Freeze.

1: [탱버] When Bribed Guard's Shield Bash lands (3 sec cast, 20% increased Physical damage taken for 20 sec), pop Vampiric Blood (1.5 min) and Death Strike to recover. Bribed Captain is on you too, so use Dancing Rune Weapon (2 min, 30% parry) on this pull as well.

[제어] When Street Sneak coats its weapons with Heartstop Poison (8 sec), stun one with Asphyxiate (45 sec) for 5 sec to slow the stacking. Absorb the Nature DoT already on you with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration).
2: [차단] Interrupt the two Seductive Sayaads' Seduction (3 sec cast), one with Mind Freeze (15 sec) and the other by Death Gripping it (2 charges with Death's Echo). Wowhead lists Seduction as a cast Death Grip can stop in this dungeon.
[위치] Stand inside the door to break line of sight, and Death Grip a Felonious Mage that stops in the doorway to channel Fel Missiles with your remaining charge.
3: [탱버] For Bribed Guard's Shield Bash, use Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction) if the Vampiric Blood from pull 1 is not back.
[탱버] When six Felwyrms die around you at once, their Fel Detonations (193965 Fire within 4 yd) overlap; pop Anti-Magic Shell to absorb them.
4: [탱버] The four Street Sneaks' Heartstop Poison stacks cut your maximum health quickly; pop Vampiric Blood (30% more maximum health) and absorb the Nature DoT with Anti-Magic Shell.
[제어] Stun one poisoned Street Sneak with Asphyxiate to slow the stacking.
5: [탱버] Massive Felwyrm's Corroding Spittle is a stacking Fire magic effect on the tank; with Anti-Magic Shell up you absorb the Fire damage and block new stacks (Wowhead: a dungeon full of magic effects).
[광역 피해] Drop Anti-Magic Zone (6 sec, 15% magic damage reduction) while Over-infused keeps triggering Burning Fel (38793 Fire within 50 yd every 3 sec).
8: [차단] Death Grip (2 charges) the two Fel Invokers to cancel their Health Funnel channels, and interrupt Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast) with Mind Freeze.
[탱버] The two Trained Felhunters' Shadow Bite (38793 Shadow per melee hit) is not reduced by Bone Shield armor; absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell.

[탱버] Shivan Punisher gains 30% Physical damage through Punishing Might each time its melee attack is missed or dodged. Wowhead warns these stacks can spike during Dancing Rune Weapon, so use Vampiric Blood instead of Dancing Rune Weapon on this pull.
9: [탱버] If you are the Drain Life target of Corrupted Warlock, pop Vampiric Blood or Icebound Fortitude so the warlock does not heal much.
[차단] Interrupt one of the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Mind Freeze and stun the other with Asphyxiate. Gather the eight Demon Flies with Gorefiend's Grasp (1.5 min).
10: [차단] Interrupt the two Fel Invokers' first Health Funnel one each with Death Grip and Mind Freeze.
[광역 피해] When Shivan Punisher drops below 50% and pulses Fire damage every second with Demonic Frenzy, drop Anti-Magic Zone. This is a Punisher pull, so do not use Dancing Rune Weapon.
11: [광역 피해] Drop Anti-Magic Zone for Felmaster Lucsei's first Blade Dance (43642 Fire every 0.4 sec), and absorb your own damage from the next Blade Dance with Anti-Magic Shell. Anti-Magic Shell also absorbs the two Trained Felhunters' Shadow Bite.
13: [광역 피해] Drop Anti-Magic Zone for Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to the whole party).
[차단] Gather the six Unleashed Imps with Gorefiend's Grasp to silence them for 3 sec, and interrupt Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage with Mind Freeze.
14: [차단] Gather and silence the six Unleashed Imps with Gorefiend's Grasp, cancel Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with Death Grip, and interrupt Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage with Mind Freeze.
[탱버] Absorb the two Trained Felhunters' Shadow Bite with Anti-Magic Shell.
15: [위치] Death Grip the Corrupted Warlock, back off and kill it first, then take the Shivan Punisher separately.
[탱버] Absorb the three Trained Felhunters' Shadow Bite with Anti-Magic Shell, and use Vampiric Blood and Icebound Fortitude instead of Dancing Rune Weapon for the Shivan Punisher.
16: [광역 피해] Defiled Golem casts Defiled Slam twice; drop Anti-Magic Zone for the first and absorb your own Fire damage from the second with Anti-Magic Shell.
[차단] Interrupt the two Fel Invokers' Health Funnel one each with Death Grip and Mind Freeze.

1: [탱버] Blood cannot soothe the Territorial Matriarchs' Mother's Wrath enrage. When stacks build, pop Dancing Rune Weapon (2 min, 30% parry), then Vampiric Blood (1.5 min). Also watch the Shredding Claws armor reduction stacks from Thornclaw Gatherers (Wowhead).
[위치] Death Grip (2 charges with Death's Echo) the Keen-Eyed Striker that flies in to steal the berry bush. Blood's Death Grip forces the gripped mob to attack you.
[광역 피해] When Spirit of Hunger channels Feast of Misery (38793 Shadow every 1 sec for 5 sec), drop Anti-Magic Zone (6 sec, 15% magic damage reduction).
2: [차단] Interrupt Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Mind Freeze (15 sec) first, and Death Grip it to cancel an Earth Bolt that comes while Mind Freeze is on cooldown.
[탱버] If you used Anti-Magic Zone on pull 1, absorb only your own share of the Feast of Misery Shadow damage with Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration).
5: [위치] While the party clicks the barrels, pop Death's Advance (10 sec, 35% movement speed) as you drag this pack to the boss spot, and Death Grip an Earthwhisper Tender that lags behind to cast.
7: [탱버] For the two Territorial Matriarchs' enrage stacks, pop Dancing Rune Weapon then Vampiric Blood, and keep Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction) for the two Matriarchs on pull 8 right after.
[차단] Interrupt the two Earthwhisper Tenders' Healing Breeze, one with Mind Freeze and the other with Death Grip.
[위치] If the mobs you gathered while circling the outside clockwise are spread out in the corner, pull them together with Gorefiend's Grasp (1.5 min).
8: [탱버] The five Frostfangs' Frostbite (67888 Frost, tank only) is not reduced by Bone Shield armor; absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell. When Bloodrush adds 60% attack speed, pop Anti-Magic Shell again once it is back (Wowhead).
[탱버] Use the Icebound Fortitude you saved on pull 7 for the two Territorial Matriarchs' enraged damage.
[광역 피해] Drop Anti-Magic Zone while Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward pulses Nature damage on the whole party every 2 sec.
9: [차단] Interrupt the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast, 50% haste and movement speed reduction), one with Mind Freeze and the other with Asphyxiate (45 sec). Lower haste slows rune regeneration and starves Death Strike.
[탱버] Absorb the two Frostfangs' Frostbite with Anti-Magic Shell.
10: [차단] Interrupt the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar one each with Mind Freeze and Death Grip.
[탱버] Absorb the three Frostfangs' Frostbite with Anti-Magic Shell, and since this is the cooldown pull after lust, also pop Dancing Rune Weapon.
11: [탱버] When you see Avatar of Determination's Pulverize (4 sec cast, 12 yd stun + 387930 Physical), step out of 12 yd; if you cannot, pop Icebound Fortitude (stun immunity, 30% damage reduction) and take it.
[참고] When you see the Glacial Tomb cast (2 sec), pre-cast Anti-Magic Shell to absorb the Frost damage (38793 every 2 sec) while encased.
[광역 피해] Drop Anti-Magic Zone for Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward Nature damage.
13: [탱버] Alternate Vampiric Blood and Icebound Fortitude for the two Grizzled Warbringers' Primal Echo (armor-ignoring party Physical, stacking). It ignores armor, so do not rely on Bone Shield alone.
[차단] Interrupt the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature), one with Mind Freeze and the other with Death Grip.
14: [탱버] The three Loyal Saberfangs stack armor reduction, so do not rely on Bone Shield armor; pop Dancing Rune Weapon and Vampiric Blood (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] When the two Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems (36368 Fire every 0.3 sec) overlap, drop Anti-Magic Zone.
[차단] Interrupt Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Mind Freeze.
15: [탱버] The four Grizzled Warbringers never cast Primal Echo at the same time, so take each Echo in order with Vampiric Blood (1.5 min) then Icebound Fortitude (2 min), and Death Strike right after an Echo when both are on cooldown. If you used Vampiric Blood on pull 14, start with Icebound Fortitude.
[차단] If the two Stormbound Mystics cast Arc Lightning from apart, gather them with Gorefiend's Grasp to silence them for 3 sec, and interrupt the next cast with Mind Freeze.
16: [차단] Put Mind Freeze (15 sec) into the Lightning Bolt kick rotation for Loa Speaker Nanea.

1: [차단] Take the first Shadowbolt Volley interrupt on Voidtouched Magi with Mind Freeze (15 sec). The assigned party member takes the second cast, and you take the third with Mind Freeze once it is back.
[탱버] If you are the Null Eruption target, move out of the party and pop Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration) to absorb the Shadow damage (145474 + 5 sec DoT).
[위치] While dragging Voidtouched Magi around the corner into the room, Death Grip (2 charges with Death's Echo) an Enthralled Shaman that stops to cast Lava Bolt.
2: [탱버] Pop Icebound Fortitude (2 min), which reduces all damage by 30%, for Raj'kess the Spellstorm's long party-wide Thundering Storm.
3: [탱버] The five Sycophantic Taraseks' Melt Armor is a magic effect, so a pre-cast Anti-Magic Shell keeps it off you (Wowhead).
[광역 피해] Drop Anti-Magic Zone (6 sec, 15% magic damage reduction) for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature every 2 sec for 10 sec).
[위치] If mobs gather inside Protective Turtle's Shell Guard, pull them out to you with Gorefiend's Grasp (1.5 min). Block Brutok's Head Bash knockback by popping Death's Advance in advance.
5: [차단] Interrupt Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 60 yd fear) with Mind Freeze, and Death Grip it to cancel the cast if the kick will be missed. If it goes off, pop Lichborne (2 min) to stay immune to the fear.
[탱버] If you are the target of Watchful Harrower's Void Beam (43642 Shadow every 0.5 sec for 4 sec), move out of the party and absorb it with Anti-Magic Shell.
6: [탱버] When Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams (party Physical every 1.5 sec, 10% stronger each slam) overlap with Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak, pop Icebound Fortitude (30% damage reduction).
[차단] Interrupt Dominated Brawler's Demoralizing Shout (4 sec cast) with Mind Freeze.
8: [탱버] Pop Vampiric Blood (1.5 min) for Devouring Brutalizer's Brutalize (678877 Physical every 1.5 sec for 6 sec) and keep facing it until it ends. For the Dreadbellow right before it (knockback + 12 sec Shadow DoT), block the knockback with Death's Advance and absorb the DoT with Anti-Magic Shell.
[차단] Interrupt Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Mind Freeze, and Death Grip Voidminder to cancel its Mending Void channel.
9: [탱버] Pop Icebound Fortitude (2 min) for Brutalize if the Vampiric Blood from pull 8 is not back. Take Dreadbellow with Death's Advance and Anti-Magic Shell.
[차단] Interrupt Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Mind Freeze, and cancel the two Voidminders' Mending Void with your two Death Grip charges.
10: [탱버] Use the returned Vampiric Blood for Brutalize, and absorb the Void Beam from the Watchful Harrower you chain-pull as the Brutalizer is nearly dead with Anti-Magic Shell.
[차단] Death Grip the two Voidminders to cancel their Mending Void channels.

1: [탱버] Pop Anti-Magic Shell (40 sec with Anti-Magic Barrier, 7 sec duration) for every Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 party-wide Shadow) from Shadow-Borne Champion. If it casts again within 40 sec, take it with Icebound Fortitude (2 min, 30% damage reduction).
[탱버] While dragging the two Animated Guardians into the Champion pack to kill them together, pop Vampiric Blood (1.5 min) when their Heavy Slams overlap.
[제어] Stun the Minion of Zul on the way with Asphyxiate (45 sec, 5 sec stun) so it cannot move while the party purges its Bound by Shadow shield.
2: [차단] Interrupt Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow + 12 sec curse DoT) with Mind Freeze (15 sec), and Death Grip it to cancel a Shadowfrost Bolt cast while Mind Freeze is on cooldown.
[탱버] For Shadow Whirlwind, pop Anti-Magic Shell again if it is back from pull 1; otherwise take it with Icebound Fortitude. Save Anti-Magic Zone for Purifying Flame in pull 5.
4: [탱버] When the King A'akul and Bloodsworn Assassin group wakes, pop Vampiric Blood (30% more maximum health and healing received) to offset Mortal Bleed's 20% healing reduction, and keep up with the Sudden Rupture bleeds using Death Strike. If Blood Drain follows after Vampiric Blood ends, pop Icebound Fortitude.

[차단] On Queen Wasi, interrupt Bind Soul first with Mind Freeze and Death Grip her to cancel Soul Bolt. If Bind Soul comes while Mind Freeze is down, pop Lichborne (2 min) so you cannot be charmed for 10 sec. Wowhead lists Lichborne as a utility for this dungeon.
